name: Sandisk (SNDK)
teaser: Fiscal 2026 profit was $11.4 billion and the stock trades at 6.9 times next year's consensus, but the four years before it added up to a loss. Reduce, no buy price.
llms: Sandisk is a NAND flash memory maker that sells to phone, PC and data center customers through a Flash Ventures joint venture with Kioxia. At $1,487.33 it trades at 6.2 times Base fiscal 2027 EBITDA, but the price needs about $33 billion of average EBITDA a year, against a five-year average net income of $1.6 billion. Bear $464, Base $962, Bull $1,664. Verdict Reduce at $1,487.33, no maximum buy price issued (Confidence D, required margin of safety 65%).
